title: An Absolutely Remarkable Thing
content: Has anyone read the book [An Absolutely Remarkable Thing](https://www.goodreads.com/book/show/24233708-an-absolutely-remarkable-thing)? One part of the plot involves everyone in the world going to a shared dreamworld when they sleep. It isn't exactly Mall World, but there are a lot of similarities. I'm thinking there's a good chance that the author has Mall World dreams, and it's fun to read someone putting them to use creatively.
